assets.name: AIUB
assets.prompt:
Mode: built-in image_gen. Revised approval preview; not installed in website.
Output: design/previews/journey-education-logo-v2.png

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit the supplied portfolio illustration (image 1). Image 2 is the official logo reference to preserve its identity.
User feedback: the background has too many things. Make the scene dramatically simpler, calmer, and less busy.
Keep the central upright AIUB circular emblem as the dominant subject, with its recognizable official blue/yellow colors, pale blue field, white shield, book, flame, computer, lettering and 1994. Preserve its crisp pixel-art treatment and warm cream stone rim. Match the original logo reference accurately.
Replace ALL the elaborate surrounding campus, buildings, dome, trees, lanterns, flowers, stairs, winding paths and elaborate pedestal with a very restrained composition: a nearly flat pale mint background with only extremely subtle pixel color variation; one small simple low cream stone base immediately beneath the emblem; a short patch of sage grass below that base, at most two tiny understated grass tufts. No other props or scenery.
The empty pale mint backdrop should occupy at least 60 percent of the total image area. The logo diameter should be about 57 percent of the image height, centered horizontally, positioned slightly above the vertical center with its low base beneath it. Leave generous empty space around the logo, fully within crop-safe central region. The logo and simple base are the only focal objects.
Maintain the portfolio's crisp square pixel clusters, deliberate stepped edges, soft warm light and limited environment palette of mint, sage and cream. Opaque landscape image 1536x1024, 3:2. Flat 2D pixel-art illustration, no realistic photography, no glossy 3D rendering. Do not add text outside the logo, UI, borders, characters, mountains, clouds, ornamental framing or extra symbols. ONE revised image.

assets.name: Hattim
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE new production portfolio illustration belonging to the same series as image 1, the approved minimal pixel-art AIUB sample. Image 1 is a STYLE AND COMPOSITION reference only. Image 2 is the authoritative BRAND LOGO reference for this new asset.
Match the approved image's quiet almost-flat pale mint background, warm pixel lighting, crisp square pixel clusters, stepped edges, one low simple cream stone base, and just a narrow patch of sage grass with at most two tiny grass tufts. At least 60% of the image is empty background. No scenery, buildings, trees, lanterns, flowers, mountains, clouds, extra symbols, UI, watermark, borders, or characters. Do NOT reproduce the university emblem or its words.
Render the supplied brand logo as the single dominant centered upright pixel-art object, with subtle material depth and a restrained cream stone edge where appropriate, resting on the small base. Preserve the exact logo silhouette, proportions, internal shapes, colors and spelling. Do not invent or redesign its logo. Front-facing, fully visible, undistorted. Keep complete subject within central 66% of canvas width and central 70% of height with generous cropping margins. Opaque landscape 1536x1024. Authentic handcrafted 16-bit pixel art, not a smooth vector scene, not photorealistic, not glossy 3D. No extra text beyond any wordmark included in reference.
Use the full lowercase black 'hattim' wordmark, distinctive tall first-letter stroke, green antenna dot over i and green underline. Present it faithfully on a simple warm ivory rectangular plaque with subtly stepped corners, width around 62% of canvas, height about 30%; one very low stone base beneath. Preserve all letters; no toy cars or other props.
